description: AI & privacy gateway: change the tenant's rules — per data_class (public, internal, personal, sensitive) the action none, pseudonymised or allowed, optionally only for one product (provider); reset=true removes a rule so the default applies again. Loosening what AI models see is a person's decision: EVERY call over MCP is parked for approval and only runs when a tenant admin approves it in the app (Approvals). IBANs stay masked whatever is set. Admins can also change the rules directly on the page 'KI & Datenschutz'.

reason.description: Why — shown to the approving admin.

rules.description: Rules to set or reset, one per data class and product

action.description: What AI may see of this class: nothing, pseudonymised or allowed

data_class.description: Data class the rule applies to

provider.description: '*' (default) = all products, or one provider: ai-call-bot, tenderaize, supportaize, bookaize, zapier, nodem, taufnaus, contecht-5d-planer, gutachten-ai-sist, ernteapp, verain, complaiance, coachaize.

reset.description: true = remove this rule; the default (or the all-products rule) applies again.

name: set_ai_privacy_rules
